stages.loadingEngine: Preparing the video engine (first time only)…

result.alreadyOptimizedHint: Re-encoding would make this file larger, so the original is kept as-is. Try a lower quality or a modern format like WebP or AVIF.

settings.gifNote: Only the first frame of animated images is converted.
settings.limitDimensionsHint: Downscale large images so the longest side fits.
settings.noUpscaleHint: Never make the image larger than the original.

modes.fitHint: Scale to fit inside the box. Keeps the original aspect ratio.
modes.fillHint: Cover the whole box and crop the overflow from the center.
modes.stretchHint: Use the exact size, distorting the image if needed.

crop.area: Crop area, {{width}} by {{height}} pixels. Use arrow keys to move.
crop.circleHint: Corners outside the circle become transparent (PNG or WebP).

removeBg.modelNote: Runs on-device with an AI model. The first run downloads the model (about 40 MB); after that it’s cached.
removeBg.subject: Subject
removeBg.shadowHint: A soft shadow under the subject.
removeBg.outlineHint: A solid border around the subject.
removeBg.cropToSubjectHint: Trim the empty space around the subject.

editor.holdToCompare: Hold to compare with the original

metadata.gpsFound: This image contains GPS location data
metadata.removeDescription: Export a clean copy without EXIF, GPS, camera details or other embedded data — useful before sharing photos publicly.
metadata.reencodeNote: Pixels are re-encoded to guarantee removal. PNG stays lossless; JPEG and WebP are saved at maximum quality.

batch.maxSizeHint: Images are scaled to fit within these bounds, keeping their aspect ratio.
batch.settingsApplyHint: Settings apply to files when processing starts.

base64.aboutDescription: Turns the image into text you can paste into HTML, CSS or JSON. Encoded output is about 33% larger than the file.
base64.truncated: Showing the first {{count}} characters. Copy or download to get the full text.
base64.inputHint: Paste a data URI (data:image/png;base64,…) or raw Base64 text.
base64.emptyDescription: Paste Base64 text and select Decode.
base64.exportPlaceholder: Decode an image to see download options.
base64.optimizeHint: A smaller image makes a much shorter Base64 string.

ico.nonSquareHint: This image isn’t square, so it will be centered on a transparent canvas.

colorPicker.hint: Click anywhere on the image to pick a color. It’s copied automatically.

effects.rotateHint: Non-right angles expand the canvas; corners stay transparent (or white for JPG).

focusHints.radial: A circle stays sharp — click the preview to move it.
focusHints.band: A horizontal strip stays sharp (tilt-shift) — click the preview to move it.

effects.autoCropHint: Trim to the largest rectangle without empty edges.
effects.mirrorHint: The kept half is reflected onto the other half for a symmetric image.

video.previewUnavailable: Preview isn’t available for this format
video.previewUnavailableHint: Your browser can’t play this file, but it can still be processed.
video.crfHint: Lower values mean better quality and larger files. 23 is a good default.
video.targetBitrateHint: Aim for a predictable file size instead of constant quality.
video.estimateDisclaimer: Actual size depends on motion and detail in the video.
video.copyStreamsHint: Fastest and lossless, but only works when the codecs fit the new container.
video.gifConvertHint: GIFs have no audio and are limited to 256 colors. For more control use Video to GIF.
video.cropNeedsPreview: This format can’t be previewed, so the crop is centered automatically.
video.evenDimensionsHint: Dimensions are rounded to even numbers for compatibility.
video.upscaleWarning: Upscaling won’t add detail and increases file size.
video.rotateNoop: Choose a rotation or flip to continue.

trim.preciseHint: Re-encodes the clip so it starts exactly where you set it. Slower.
trim.fastHint: Instant and lossless. Cuts snap to the nearest keyframe, so the start may shift slightly.

modeHints.keep: Only the selected part is kept.
modeHints.remove: The selected part is removed and the rest is joined together.

mute.title: Audio
mute.description: All audio tracks are removed. The video stream is copied as-is, so quality stays identical and it’s fast.
mute.adjustDescription: Make the sound louder or quieter, even out the loudness, or fade it in and out. The picture isn't re-encoded for MP4 and MOV.
mute.normalizeHint: Evens out quiet and loud parts to a standard streaming level.

formats.mp3: Plays everywhere. Good balance of size and quality.
formats.wav: Uncompressed. Best for editing, large files.
formats.aac: Efficient codec used by Apple devices (.m4a).

audio.partHint: Extract only this range. Leave it as is for the whole audio.

addAudio.replaceHint: The new track replaces the original audio.
addAudio.mixHint: The new track plays over the original audio.
addAudio.loopHint: Repeat the track if it’s shorter than the video.
addAudio.skip: Skip the first part of the track

speed.title: Playback speed
speed.sameSpeed: Pick a speed other than 1× to continue.
speed.keepAudioHint: Audio is time-stretched with natural pitch.

audioHints.keep: Audio is sped up or slowed down without changing its pitch.
audioHints.pitch: Like a tape: faster sounds higher, slower sounds deeper.

speed.smoothHint: Blends in-between frames instead of repeating them. Slower to process.

gif.repeatHint: How many times the animation plays in the video.
gif.upscaleHint: Sharp pixel scaling — ideal for pixel art and small GIFs.

thumbnail.needsPlayable: This format can’t be played in your browser. Convert it to MP4 first.

modeHints.frame: Scrub to any moment and save that frame.
modeHints.sheet: A grid of frames taken evenly across the whole video.

thumbnail.headerHint: File name, duration and resolution above the grid.

modeHints.repeat: Plays the clip again and again. Fast and lossless.
modeHints.boomerang: Plays forward, then backward. Re-encoded, without audio.

reverse.title: Reverse
reverse.audioHint: Turn off to remove the audio instead.
reverse.longWarning: Reversing needs lots of memory. Parts longer than {{seconds}} seconds may fail in the browser — pick a shorter part below.
reverse.partHint: Reverse only this part — shorter parts use far less memory.

fps.title: Frame rate
fps.hint: Lower frame rates make smaller files. To raise the frame rate smoothly, choose Blend or Motion.

methodHints.drop: Fastest. Frames are repeated or dropped — motion looks the same as before.
methodHints.blend: Mixes neighbouring frames for a softer, smoother look.
methodHints.motion: Estimates in-between frames for real smoothness. Much slower — best for short clips.

frames.title: Frame extraction
frames.countHint: Spread evenly over the chosen part.

merge.title: Merge clips
merge.description: Clips are joined in the order shown and exported as MP4.
merge.audioDropped: Some clips had no audio, so the merged video is silent.
merge.keepAudioHint: Turn off for a silent video (e.g. to add music later).

validation.dimensionTooLarge: That’s larger than browsers can handle (16,384 px max).
validation.bitrateRange: Bitrate must be between 100 and 50,000 kbps.
validation.timeRangeOrder: End time must be after the start time.
validation.timeRangeBounds: End time is past the end of the video.
validation.base64Invalid: This isn’t valid Base64 image data.
validation.base64TooLarge: This image is too large to decode (10 MB max).
validation.fpsRange: Frame rate must be between 1 and 120.
validation.intervalRange: Interval must be at least 0.04 seconds.
validation.mergeMinClips: Add at least two clips to merge.
validation.promptRequired: Describe what you want to create.
validation.seedRange: Seed must be a whole number of 0 or more.
validation.fadeRequired: Set a fade in or fade out duration.
validation.fadeTooLong: The fades are longer than the video.
validation.splitRange: Choose settings that create between 2 and {{max}} parts.
validation.targetSize: Enter a size of at least 5 KB.

UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.title: This file format is not supported.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.title: This file is too large.
FILE_TOO_LARGE.description: Choose a file smaller than the limit for this tool.

CORRUPTED_FILE.title: This file couldn’t be read.
CORRUPTED_FILE.description: It may be damaged or use an encoding your browser doesn’t support.

PROCESSING_FAILED.title: Something went wrong while processing your file.
PROCESSING_FAILED.description: Please try again. If it keeps happening, try different settings or another file.

BROWSER_UNSUPPORTED.title: Your browser doesn’t support this feature.
BROWSER_UNSUPPORTED.description: Try the latest version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

OUT_OF_MEMORY.title: Not enough memory to finish.
OUT_OF_MEMORY.description: The file is too demanding for the browser. Try a shorter clip, a lower resolution, or close other tabs.

FFMPEG_INIT_FAILED.title: The video engine couldn’t start.
FFMPEG_INIT_FAILED.description: Reload the page and try again. Some privacy extensions block WebAssembly.

CONVERSION_FAILED.title: Conversion failed.
CONVERSION_FAILED.description: This file couldn’t be converted with these settings. Try another format or turn off stream copy.

NETWORK_ERROR.title: Network error.
NETWORK_ERROR.description: A required resource couldn’t be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.

BACKGROUND_REMOVAL_FAILED.title: Background removal failed.
BACKGROUND_REMOVAL_FAILED.description: The subject couldn’t be separated from the background. Try an image with a clearer subject.

INVALID_DIMENSIONS.title: Invalid dimensions.
INVALID_DIMENSIONS.description: Width and height must be positive and within browser limits.

INVALID_CROP.title: Invalid crop area.
INVALID_CROP.description: Select an area inside the image.

INVALID_TIME_RANGE.title: Invalid time range.
INVALID_TIME_RANGE.description: The end time must be after the start time and within the video.

TOO_MANY_FILES.title: Too many files.
TOO_MANY_FILES.description: You can add up to {{max}} files at once.

INVALID_BASE64.title: Invalid Base64 data.
INVALID_BASE64.description: Paste a complete data URI or Base64-encoded image.

NO_AUDIO_STREAM.title: No audio found.
NO_AUDIO_STREAM.description: This video doesn’t contain an audio track.

UNKNOWN.title: Something went wrong.
UNKNOWN.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

AI_KEY_REQUIRED.title: An API key is needed.
AI_KEY_REQUIRED.description: Paste your free API key in the settings panel. Use the “Get a free key” link to create one.

AI_UNAUTHORIZED.title: The API key was rejected.
AI_UNAUTHORIZED.description: Check that the key is correct and active in your {{provider}} account.

AI_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.title: Not enough credits for this model.
AI_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.description: Pick a model marked Free, wait for your daily free credits to refresh, or top up your {{provider}} account.

AI_RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests.
AI_RATE_LIMITED.description: The AI service is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.

AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.title: This model isn’t available.
AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.description: Choose another model from the list.

AI_GENERATION_FAILED.title: Generation failed.
AI_GENERATION_FAILED.description: The AI service couldn’t create this. Try rephrasing the prompt or another model.

PDF_PROTECTED.title: This PDF is password-protected.
PDF_PROTECTED.description: Remove the password in your PDF reader, then try again.

about.title: About Refract
about.intro: Refract is a set of focused media tools that run entirely in your browser. It’s built for people who work with images and video every day and want fast results without uploading their files anywhere.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Images are processed with the Canvas API inside Web Workers, with WebAssembly codecs for formats like AVIF. Videos use FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly, loaded only when you open a video tool.

sections.title: Built to grow
sections.body: The architecture separates tools, processing services and providers, so features like saved presets, cloud processing, larger file limits or an API can be added without changing how tools behave.

sections.title: Open standards
sections.body: Output files use widely supported formats — MP4, WebM, PNG, JPG, WebP and AVIF — so they work everywhere you need them.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Your files are processed on your device. Refract doesn’t upload, store or analyze the media you open.

sections.title: Local processing
sections.body: Every tool runs in your browser tab. Files stay in memory only while you work and are released when you leave or clear them.

sections.title: What we store
sections.body: Only your language and theme preferences are saved in your browser’s local storage. The recent jobs list keeps file names and tool names for the current session only.

sections.title: Downloaded components
sections.body: The background remover downloads its AI model from IMG.LY’s content network the first time you use it. Only the model is downloaded — your images are never sent.
